rules.title: any escapes type safety
rules.description: Explicit any, as-any cast, or implicit any at a boundary — pushes type errors to runtime. Suggest the precise type or unknown + narrowing.

rules.title: Non-null assertion masks a check
rules.description: The ! operator asserting away nullability where the value can actually be null/undefined on a reachable path.

rules.title: Floating promise
rules.description: A promise created without await, return, or .catch — rejections become unhandled and ordering is lost.

rules.title: Loose equality
rules.description: == / != with coercion where === was intended (null/undefined checks excepted if deliberate).

rules.title: Unhandled rejection path
rules.description: async function or promise chain with no error handling at the boundary — failures surface as unhandled rejections.

rules.title: Direct state/props mutation
rules.description: Mutating props, store state, or shared objects in place where immutability is expected (React/Redux/NgRx patterns).
